name: Single-scattering homogeneous volume rendering
aliases: Single monochromatic homogeneous volume with absorption and single-scattering
definition: A volumetric path tracer that adds single scattering to the absorption-only model. It assumes a single homogeneous volume, monochromatic coefficients, surfaces that only emit light, and that light scatters exactly once within the volume.
summary: Single-scattering homogeneous volume rendering simulates light scattering exactly once in a uniform medium, distinguishing itself by ignoring secondary bounces and assuming constant material properties.
